summary: The proposed fix addresses the issue but introduces potential regressions and lacks comprehensive tests.

issues.description: The fix modifies the behavior of TensorProduct expansion, which may inadvertently affect other parts of the codebase that rely on the current behavior.
There are no additional tests provided to ensure the fix works correctly across various scenarios, including edge cases.
The code changes could be improved for readability and maintainability by adding comments explaining the new logic.
